accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
The ecosystem capability-gap audit is complete enough to establish a ranked next expansion campaign without adding a new active skill yet.

Quality Engineering is the first top-level promotion candidate because independent product-quality strategy, exploratory testing, E2E/regression, visual/accessibility verification, and readiness evidence are not fully owned by Software Development or Release Engineering.

Cloudflare Platform is the second top-level promotion candidate because repeated Creator workflows span Workers, Pages, D1, R2, Access, Tunnel, networking, Wrangler, observability, and agent infrastructure across multiple projects.
Database Engineering is a third candidate, but schema/index/query/migration/concurrency knowledge should begin as reference packs and earn promotion through recurring outcome evidence.
Flutter, Android, Postgres/Supabase/Neon, Terraform/IaC, observability/SRE, and browser/computer automation are reference-pack-first areas rather than immediate new top-level faculties.
Browser and computer control are execution surfaces; QA, Research, Automations, or another domain owner should own the task intent.

Healthcare and clinical-informatics acquisition remains a later high-bar area: prefer bounded interoperability, evidence retrieval, terminology, documentation, and de-identified data workflows over a generic doctor or autonomous clinical-reasoning skill.

Bulk marketplace imports, popularity-driven promotion, weakly grounded generic medical/persona skills, and thin vendor wrappers that duplicate existing ownership are rejected as top-level expansion strategies.
Existing Cognitive Runtime, authority, delegation, recovery, context, trajectory, self-improvement, and GitHub mutation contracts remain in force.
unresolved_risks: The public skill ecosystem is large and uneven; first-party provenance improves confidence but does not prove DEDAL-specific outcome gains.
Quality Engineering currently lacks one canonical first-party cross-framework skill corpus, so methodology synthesis must separate durable QA principles from tool-specific community conventions.
Cloudflare product facts and APIs can drift quickly; any specialist skill must bias toward live official documentation rather than freezing a large product manual into Core.
Database Engineering may overlap Software Development and Data Operations unless its ownership boundary is kept to database semantics and operational behavior.
Healthcare skill ecosystems contain useful domain workflows but carry higher factual and safety stakes; generic clinical automation must not be promoted from popularity or vendor claims alone.
Capability candidates remain discovery-level until representative real-task baselines and regression evidence justify promotion.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit quality-engineering methodology and representative QA skill/tool corpora. Define the exact ownership boundary against Software Development, Interface Design, Release Engineering, and Automations; extract durable patterns; design baseline/evaluation cases from real DEDAL project workflows; then decide whether Quality Engineering merits top-level activation.
